excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上古怪工厂工作的员工突然消失了！我们可以派遣工人替补，或者以防万一，直接将工厂夷为平地。
excerpt.en: The crew we assigned to work the odd factory on [Root.GetName] has disappeared! We could send a new workforce to take their place, or we could raze the facility to the ground, making sure that this will not happen again.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上古怪工厂工作的员工突然消失了！我们可以派遣工人替补，或者以防万一，直接将工厂夷为平地。
texts.en: The crew we assigned to work the odd factory on [Root.GetName] has disappeared! We could send a new workforce to take their place, or we could raze the facility to the ground, making sure that this will not happen again.

texts.zh:
到那个古怪工厂工作后，第二队工人也失踪了！所幸，其中一个工人留下了记录。记录显示那里有不少的陷阱，这些陷阱专门用来抓捕毫无防备的工人。

陷阱已经移除，现在应该可以正常使用工厂了。但不论如何解释，民众仍对潜在的致命陷阱忧心忡忡。
texts.en:
A second group of individuals has gone missing after working at the odd factory! Fortunately one of the workers was able to leave a recording behind, revealing that there are traps capturing unsuspecting workers.

The traps have been disabled and we should be able to use the factory without further issues. However, the populace are none too happy about the potential death trap, no matter what we say.

label.en: The people will get used to it.
